records.name: QingPu WQP-WQP518MA
records.role: Panel jack candidate for all 157 ports
records.listing_state: JLC Global Sourcing entry names Wenzhou QingPu. Retrieved page says unavailable for purchase and offers consignment. Not a stocked-part promise.
facts: Front-entry 3.5 mm mono switching jack, threaded panel bushing.
Retained Thonk/PJ398SM family drawing: 9 mm body width; 6 + 4.5 = 10.5 mm body projection in the other direction.
Family side view: 9 mm body depth + 5.5 mm bushing projection; solder tails excluded. Bushing drawn as diameter 6 mm; thread pitch is not established by that drawing.
Overlay default: rotate the family body 90 degrees in the panel plane so its 9 mm axis follows the close vertical jack pitch. Jack centres do not move.
The old generic JLC Assembly code C9900079089 did not identify the manufacturer. It is not evidence of equivalence.
LCSC C53058333 separately names QingPu, but LCSC availability is not JLC assembly acceptance.
caveats: Use an incoming exact WQP518MA drawing or sample before footprint freeze; PJ398SM is a family reference.
EARS nut thread, outer diameter, thickness and fit remain open.
The switched contact is unused unless deliberately required by the final circuit. No inter-block normalled connections.
Neither a front-hole symbol nor the family body overlay is a qualified solder-pad/lead footprint.

records.name: ALPS RK09L1140A5L
records.role: Rotary-pot mechanical baseline, not a frozen electrical BOM for every position
records.listing_state: Named ALPS JLC entry retrieved; Extended, through-hole / Wave Soldering, fixture required. Quantity and price must be checked for the actual order.
facts: 10 kOhm linear (1B), no centre detent; 300 degrees +/-5 degrees travel.
6 mm flat shaft, 4.5 mm D dimension; nominal shaft length L1=15 mm from the drawing datum, not the visible height above a panel.
M9 x 0.75 threaded bushing; nominal bushing length 5 mm.
Drawing No.3 front body/support width 12.1 mm; main body projection extends 4.85 mm above the shaft centre and 6.5 mm below it. Electrical terminals and footprint pads require their own envelope.
Drawing No.3: mounting surface to shaft-base datum 10 mm; nominal shaft-tip reach 10+15=25 mm.
Attached hardware drawing: nut 11 mm across flats and 2 mm thick; washer 14 mm OD, 9.1 mm ID and 0.5 mm thick.
caveats: The 14/9 mm caps in the artwork are unselected cap envelopes, not dimensions of this potentiometer.
A 14 mm washer is wider than a 9 mm small knob and can cover small Corner Keys artwork if fitted on top of the panel.
Use the optional washer overlay to see this conflict. Do not remove required retention hardware simply to hide it.
Manufacturer DC limit is 10 V; do not wire the pot across -12 V and +12 V. Review wiper loading, DC-use guidance and the actual circuit.
Low-priority pots may instead use a bushingless candidate; no blanket component assignment has been approved.

records.name: ALPS RS20H111C009
records.role: All twelve AR faders: selected mechanical reference
records.listing_state: C470622 is the previously identified catalog code. Current exact JLC page could not be retrieved in R06. Manufacturer dimensions were verified; live JLC stock and order acceptance were NOT verified.
facts: 50 kOhm linear (1B); no detent; top-operated vertical C lever.
20 mm travel, 35 mm nominal body length. The length tolerance on Drawing No.2 is +/-0.1 mm where not individually specified.
6 mm main side-view body width; top projection includes 4.5 mm on one side of the lever axis and 2.8 +/-0.3 mm on the other. Overlay shows the nominal 7.3 mm combined side envelope, not just 6 mm.
Body height 12.5 +/-0.3 mm above mounting surface.
Lever L1=14.5 +/-0.3 mm from its designated datum. Total nominal lever-tip height is L1+13=27.5 mm; drawing gives +/-0.5 mm for the total dimension.
Lever tip cross-section is 4 mm (0/-0.1) along travel by 1.8 mm (0/-0.2) across travel.
Support-hole pitch along body is 32.5 mm. The 3 electrical terminals and mechanical lugs require the complete mounting drawing.
Current R05/R06 RISE and FALL centres are 36 mm apart. Two centred nominal 35 mm bodies leave 1 mm; at 35.1 mm each, 0.9 mm remains before placement tolerances.
caveats: The endpoint travel is not the front-panel slot length. A 4 mm-long lever moving 20 mm sweeps 24 mm along travel before cutout clearances and tolerances.
R06 uses a 24.6 x 2.4 mm illustrative slot around the swept stem: 0.3 mm clearance on each side. It is a planning assumption, not a manufacturer-approved cutout.
Default view now shows a bare 1.8 x 4 mm lever tip instead of the invented 6 x 3 mm cap. The old cap can be overlaid only as an unqualified reference.
No slider-cap SKU is selected. Cap sweep, retention, wobble and hand access must be checked.
All bodies must clear the underside of the single flat panel. Separate PCB mounting heights may be required.
10 V DC operating limit and manufacturer DC-use/wiper-loading guidance still apply.

records.name: Bourns PTV09A-4020F-B103
records.role: Alternative for small controls where a large top washer is undesirable
records.listing_state: Exact JLC listing found in search results; displayed zero stock and pre-order. This is an alternative, not a stocked approved substitute.
facts: 10 kOhm linear, bushingless rear-mount configuration 4, no detent, nominal 20 mm flat insulated shaft.
Manufacturer F shaft: diameter 6 mm; D dimension 4.5 mm. No panel nut on this bushingless variant.
Manufacturer states 20 V DC maximum; do not span the full 24 V between -12 and +12 V.
caveats: Not silently substituted in the panel: current body overlay remains the ALPS baseline.
Needs exact shaft reach, knob-retention, board support, pad layout and quantity review.
A small 9 mm cap still needs a selected compatible SKU.

records.name: EARS 3.5 mm jack dress nuts
records.listing_state: External mechanical accessory specified by the user. Exact product page unavailable in this retrieval; collection warns of incompatible larger-diameter jacks.
facts: Colors fixed by the project: black input, red output.
8.3 mm OD is inherited R05 artwork, NOT a verified dimension of this EARS product.
R06 can display a larger trial envelope, explicitly labeled an assumption.
caveats: Confirm OD, thickness, bore/thread and seated fit with the selected jack.
One confirmed jack/nut pairing should set the pitch and decorative keepout for all 157 ports.
Fitting nuts is mechanical assembly; electrical soldering remains at the factory.

records.name: Six-position octave selector — exact SKU not frozen
facts: OCT is an indexed rotary switch, not the continuous pot used for TUNE and FINE.
The 14 mm cap is only an artwork envelope. Its body, terminals and PCB clearance are not qualified.
caveats: A passing 14 mm front-cap clearance does not prove a rotary switch fits underneath.

records.name: Other switches / trigger buttons / caps
facts: No new switch, trigger-button or cap dimensions are invented in this revision.
caveats: Keep these provisional until exact variant drawings are accepted; R06 is not a fabrication package.
